translation.help: This bot can help your communities organize around quests and to exchange goods and services with each other! click on the menu to see the available options.
translation.name: Name
translation.usage: Please enter a title as part of the command. Example: /{{type}} do the dishes
translation.shoppingusage: Please specify an item to buy. eg: /{{type}} milk
translation.shoppingempty: Your shopping list is empty. Use /buy to add items.
translation.appreciationusage: Please mention the name of the user(s) you want to send appreciation to using '@', followed by the reason.
translation.expenseempty: There are no recorded expenses, use /spent to add expenses
translation.expensejoinfail: Unable to join the split. It might not exist, or you are already part of it.
translation.expenseaddusage: Please specify the user to add
translation.expenseremoveusage: Please specify the user to remove
translation.appreciationunknownuser: The user {{user}} is not subscribed. Ask the user to complete a task or type /join to subscribe.
translation.appreciationfailed: Appreciation failed. The user(s) might not exist or might not be subscribed.
translation.appreciationsuccess: {{sender}} has sent appreciation to {{receivers}} users for {{action}}
translation.onlyinitiatorpublish: Only the initiator or admins can publish this quest
translation.onlyinitiatorcast: Only the initiator or admins can cast this quest
translation.onlyinitiatorbroadcast: Only the initiator or admins can broadcast this quest
translation.settings_specify_timezone: Please specify the timezone. Example: /setTimezone Europe/London
translation.settings_admin_only: Only a chat admin can perform this action
translation.settings_enter_new_items: Please enter new {{type}} (separate multiple items with commas or new lines):
translation.settings_federation_created: This chat has been federated with {{federationID}}
translation.settings_specify_language: Please specify the language. Example: /setLanguage en
translation.settings_specify_theme: Please specify the theme. Example: /setTheme light
translation.settings_specify_federation: Please specify the ID you would like to federate with. Example: /federate 123456. This chat ID is {{chatID}}
translation.settings_specify_separation: Please specify who you would like to revoke the federation with. Example: /separate 123456.
translation.settings_specify_roles: Please specify the roles. Example: /setRoles role1 role2
translation.settings_specify_values:
Please specify the values, separated by commas or newlines. Examples:

1. Using commas:
/setValues Collaboration, Communication, Pro-activity

2. Using newlines:
/setValues
Collaboration
Communication
Pro-activity
